name: Irad
title: Descendant of Cain
summary: Irad was the son of Enoch and the grandson of Cain, the first murderer in the Bible. He is mentioned in Cain's genealogy in Genesis 4. Irad is the father of Mehujael and represents part of the Cainite line that moved away from God.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Cain's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Irad is mentioned as the son of Enoch and the grandson of Cain in the Cainite genealogy recorded in Genesis.

keyEvents.title: Father of Mehujael
keyEvents.description: Irad became the father of Mehujael, who continued Cain's lineage through several generations up to Lamech.

keyEvents.title: Part of Cain's lineage
keyEvents.description: Irad belonged to the line that descended from Cain, who was banished from God's presence after killing his brother Abel. This line developed civilization but lived separated from God.

keyEvents.title: Cain's Genealogy and Cultural Development
keyEvents.description: Irads descendants became known for developing various cultural and technological skills, including music, metalworking, and nomadic livestock herding.
